name: Azure Blob Storage
description: Protects against destructive Azure Blob Storage operations like container \ deletion, blob deletion, and azcopy remove.

destructive_patterns.name: az-storage-container-delete
destructive_patterns.description: az storage container delete removes an Azure storage container.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting an Azure storage container removes all blobs within it permanently. \ Unless soft delete is enabled, data cannot be recovered. Applications and \ services referencing this container will fail.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - az storage container list: Review containers first \ - az storage blob list -c X: Inventory contents \ - Enable soft delete before testing deletions

destructive_patterns.name: az-storage-blob-delete-batch
destructive_patterns.description: az storage blob delete-batch removes multiple blobs from Azure storage.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Batch deletion removes many blobs at once based on patterns. Without soft \ delete enabled, removed blobs cannot be recovered. Patterns may match more \ files than expected.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - az storage blob list --pattern: Preview matching blobs \ - Enable soft delete for recovery window \ - azcopy copy to backup before deletion

destructive_patterns.name: az-storage-blob-delete
destructive_patterns.description: az storage blob delete removes a blob from Azure storage.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a single blob removes it from storage. Without soft delete, the data \ is permanently lost. Applications expecting this blob will receive 404 errors.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - az storage blob show: Verify blob before deletion \ - az storage blob download: Backup content first \ - Enable soft delete for recovery

destructive_patterns.name: az-storage-account-delete
destructive_patterns.description: az storage account delete removes an entire Azure storage account.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
Deleting a storage account removes all containers, blobs, tables, queues, \ and file shares within it. The account name may not be immediately reclaimable. \ All dependent applications will fail completely.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - az storage account show: Review account configuration \ - azcopy copy: Backup all data before deletion \ - Verify no active resources depend on this account

destructive_patterns.name: azcopy-remove
destructive_patterns.description: azcopy remove deletes files from Azure storage.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
The azcopy remove command deletes blobs from Azure storage. With --recursive, \ entire directory trees are removed. Without soft delete, data is permanently \ lost and cannot be recovered.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - azcopy list: Preview files to be deleted \ - Enable soft delete before removing \ - azcopy copy to backup location first

destructive_patterns.name: azcopy-sync-delete
destructive_patterns.description: azcopy sync --delete-destination removes destination files not in source.
destructive_patterns.explanation:
The --delete-destination flag removes files from the destination that don't \ exist in the source. If source and destination are swapped, or if source is \ unexpectedly empty, this can cause complete data loss.

\ Safer alternatives: \ - azcopy sync --dry-run: Preview changes first \ - azcopy sync without --delete-destination: Only adds/updates \ - Backup destination before syncing
